content:
**Can Do!** is a Luck-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

A chance to increase amount of packaged food found based on Luck. The chance is also based on Luck.

| Luck | Trigger Chance | 
| 1 ≤ LCK < 15 | 20% | 
| 15 ≤ LCK < 30 | 40% | 
| 30 ≤ LCK < 60 | 60% | 
| 60 ≤ LCK ≤ 100 | 85% | 

| ![FO76 can do! perk bonus](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/5/5e/FO76_can_do%21_perk_bonus.png) | |
